summary: The diff implements admin backend authentication, frontend admin panel pages (theme, page management, pricing, payment gateways, payment dashboard), UI improvements (enhanced styling, logo integration), and full functionality for Compounding calculator, Exchange converters (FX/Crypto), and Tools page calculators (Risk, Margin, P/L, Lot Size, Swap). However, many backend storage requirements, real-time features, and comprehensive admin functionalities are missing or incomplete.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create comprehensive admin authentication system in backend with role-based access control
missing_requirements.reason: Backend only adds basic admin permission checks using AccessControl.hasPermission but does not include dedicated admin authentication methods, admin role storage, separate admin principal management, or session persistence as specified in acceptance criteria.

missing_requirements.requirement: Build admin theme management system with backend storage and global frontend application
missing_requirements.reason: AdminThemeSettings.tsx provides UI for theme selection, but there is no backend storage implementation for theme configuration, no backend methods to save/retrieve theme settings, and no mechanism to apply theme changes across all user sessions.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement admin page management system with backend storage and dynamic navigation updates
missing_requirements.reason: AdminPageManagement.tsx provides UI for toggling page visibility and ordering, but there is no backend storage for page configuration, no backend methods to save/retrieve page settings, and no dynamic sidebar updates based on admin configuration.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create admin subscription pricing management with backend storage and dynamic pricing application
missing_requirements.reason: AdminPricingSettings.tsx provides UI for pricing editor, but there is no backend storage for subscription pricing configuration, no backend methods to save/retrieve pricing data, and Subscribe page does not fetch pricing from backend configuration.

missing_requirements.requirement: Build payment gateway integration system supporting Stripe, Razorpay, Coinbase Commerce, and NOWPayments with backend storage for encrypted API keys
missing_requirements.reason: AdminPaymentGateways.tsx provides UI for entering API credentials for all four gateways, but backend only has Stripe configuration. No backend storage for Razorpay, Coinbase Commerce, or NOWPayments credentials, no encryption implementation for API keys, no API key validation before saving, and no automatic use of configured gateway credentials.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create admin payment management dashboard with real-time transaction display, filtering, search, and export capabilities
missing_requirements.reason: AdminPayments.tsx displays mock transaction data with filtering UI, but there are no backend query methods for retrieving payment transactions, no real-time updates mechanism, and no actual CSV/PDF export implementation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Redesign application logo to be impressive, professional, and modern
missing_requirements.reason: Logo path is updated to use propfolio-logo.dim_400x120.png in Sidebar and LandingPage, but the actual logo image file is not present in the diff (only referenced). Cannot verify if logo is professional, modern, or maintains quality at different sizes.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement full functionality for Payouts module with backend storage, add/edit/delete operations, and sortable table
missing_requirements.reason: Payouts.tsx only shows empty state with add button. No backend storage for payout records, no add payout form implementation, no payout history table display, no edit/delete functionality, and no summary statistics calculation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement full functionality for Expenses module with backend storage, category selection, and monthly breakdowns
missing_requirements.reason: Expenses.tsx shows summary cards but no backend storage for expense records, no add expense form with category dropdowns, no expense list with edit/delete options, and no monthly breakdown chart.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement full functionality for Trading Overview module with backend storage, trade entry, and comprehensive statistics
missing_requirements.reason: TradingOverview.tsx displays metric cards with placeholder data. No backend storage for trade records, no trade entry form implementation, no actual calculation of win rate/profit factor from real data, and no equity curve chart rendering based on trade history.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement full functionality for Reviews & Disputes module with backend storage and submission history
missing_requirements.reason: ReviewsDisputes.tsx only shows placeholder text. No backend storage for reviews or disputes, no submission forms, no display of submission history, and no status tracking.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement full functionality for Income Tax Calculator with country selection, backend tax rules, and quarterly payment estimates
missing_requirements.reason: IncomeTaxCalculator.tsx only shows placeholder. No country dropdown, no backend storage for tax rules, no tax calculation logic, no tax breakdown display, and no quarterly payment estimates.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration module for backend actor configuration
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not mention any backend migration functionality. The migration.mo file appears to migrate stripeConfig to configuration, which is not requested.
